author: claude-code
rationale: npm name free, no Claude Code project uses it, strongest headline hook

text: How do users customize the look?
author: claude-code

text: Launch ships the live session visualizer plus a written plan for a full skin
author: claude-code
rationale: One clear demo clip; the full skin follows on the same theme format
cost_if_wrong: If the clip doesn't land alone, the skin plan has to be pulled forward

text: Users customize through theme files plus built-in presets, switched live by a slash command
author: claude-code
rationale: Anyone can edit a file; shared themes keep the launch spreading; the full skin extends the same file
cost_if_wrong: Theme schema becomes a public contract; breaking it breaks shared themes

text: What is the hero piece and where does it live?
author: claude-code

text: Hero piece is a 4-row companion band above the prompt, shown only during a turn; the transcript keeps Claude Code's layout with a light restyle
author: claude-code
rationale: Panels were spectacle without use; restyle alone read as a themed Claude Code; 9 rows took too much space
cost_if_wrong: If the band reads as clutter, the hero shrinks to restyle + moments

text: Where does the character art come from?
author: claude-code

text: Ship the hand-drawn block-character sprites as a built-in set that works in every terminal; spritesheet art is an additional set for terminals that show images
author: claude-code
rationale: User likes the hand-drawn look; block art is the only option in terminals without image support
cost_if_wrong: Two art pipelines to keep in sync per action

text: Is the pet required, and can it talk?
author: claude-code

text: Pet and speech bubbles are both optional toggles; with the pet off the band collapses to one text line
author: claude-code
rationale: Not everyone wants a character; the text line keeps the useful part
cost_if_wrong: Every pet feature needs a text-only equivalent in the one-line band

text: Bubble text comes from per-event templates in the theme file (with variants); an opt-in chatty mode has Haiku write quips
author: claude-code
rationale: Free, instant and accurate by default; themes give the pet a voice
cost_if_wrong: Template sets per theme are content work; chatty mode adds token cost and can misstate facts

text: Use the hand-drawn Clawd block sprites for now; the user is still looking for shippable spritesheet alternatives
author: claude-code
rationale: Unblocks the build; art can be swapped through the theme file
revisit: before public launch: Clawd is Anthropic's mascot
cost_if_wrong: If Clawd can't ship as default, the default sprite set changes before launch
